boundaries: Operator/representation obstruction only, not a no-go theorem for the true complement.
Critical or n-dependent tuning is unresolved.
Oscillatory Laguerre cancellation, signed transforms, and other analytic representations are outside scope.
statement: When the first fixed-margin cutoff scale at which an absolute source-times-kernel envelope certifies a negligible complement is already a scale where local-to-global transport leaves the root-sensitive burden entirely on the retained local statistic, that envelope does not by itself provide a robust strict-reduction window. Below the balance its bound may be vacuous; above it the complement may be too small to separate obligations.
